title: Cycle Dry · Orbea
subtitle: Rear rack redesign for bikepacking
deck: A simpler, cheaper bikepacking rack with a hanger to dry clothes on the move.

sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: Orbea's MTB hardtail rack costs €124.99 and has many parts. The brief: make it simpler and cheaper for bikepacking. The user is a young cyclist on long routes who needs to wash and hang her sweaty clothes without losing them.

sections.title: Research
paragraphs: The rack was cut into nine samples and tested for density, Vickers hardness and EDX composition: mostly Al 6061, an Al 3003 mudguard, an AISI 1030 steel rod, a PET bag panel and a DLC coating. Six competitors were mapped by price and added value to find the gap.

sections.title: Concepts
paragraphs: Rotating sketches produced many redesigns. The chosen one adds a rectangular hanger on the rear bar that lifts 90° to hang clothes and turns 180° to avoid drag, or to dry them when parked.

sections.title: Development
paragraphs: The side bar between the stays was removed, since panniers now hang from the top bars, and the frame became a single bent tube plus the front and rear bars.

sections.title: Manufacturing
paragraphs: Extruded aluminium tubes, CNC bending, MIG welding and anodising for the frame. The hinge is made from extruded profiles with CNC turning and milling, drilling and tapping.
